ack.title: Acknowledge the alert

emptyHelp: The collector raises alerts on pools, zones, HA, DDNS, nodes and DNS/DHCP mismatches.

ignore.title: Ignore: admin's choice

ignore.commentHelp: Required, kept with the exception and in the audit log

exceptions.title: Consistency exceptions

exceptions.author: By

exceptions.emptyHelp: Ignore an inconsistency from its alert or from the orphan PTR page.
